Mission intake.evidence: 3 missions defined via define_mission(), all accepted and created with task graphs

Discovery.evidence: Mission A task A1 produced discovery artifact. Mission B task B1 produced discovery. Mission C task C1 attempted but failed.

Planning.evidence: Task graphs defined in specs with depends_on. No dynamic replanning observed.

Dynamic task graph.evidence: Depends_on respected (BLOCKED tasks waited). No dynamic graph modification observed.

Agent assignment.evidence: 12 IMPLEMENTER agents assigned to tasks across 3 missions. Agents picked from pool.

Tool execution.evidence: MissionTaskAgent.write_file executed for artifacts. No other tools observed.

Sandbox execution.evidence: SandboxManager.write_artifact used for all artifact creation. Isolation per task.
Sandbox execution.reproducibility: Verified - all artifacts created via sandbox

Artifact creation.evidence: 10 artifacts created across 3 missions (3+4+3). All stored with mission_id.

Verification.evidence: VERIFIER agents registered but never executed. All evidence.verified=false. Verification = automatic criteria check only.

Failure detection.evidence: 3 failures detected (A3, B3, C1) with explicit FAILED state. Error messages captured.

Recovery.evidence: No recovery attempted for any failed task. No retry, no replan, no human gate for failed tasks.

Same-mission resume.evidence: No mission was paused and resumed. Checkpoint test was post-mission simulation.

Replanning.evidence: No replanning occurred. All missions stalled after first failure.

Human gate.evidence: Human gate created and checkpoint preserved it in same-process test. No actual human interaction or cross-runtime test.
Human gate.reproducibility: Mechanism exists but not fully exercised

Cross-runtime durability.evidence: No process termination/restart tested. Checkpoint created and read in same runtime only.

Final completion.evidence: No mission completed. All 3 missions stalled with 0 completed tasks (only 1 failed + 11/9/7 blocked per mission).

Mission isolation.evidence: 4/4 isolation flags verified. Distinct IDs, artifacts, evidence, events.

Concurrent mission management.evidence: 3 missions started concurrently, executed overlapping, state tracked separately.

Interruption resilience.evidence: No actual interruption during mission execution. Post-mission simulation only.

Idempotency control.evidence: Attempt ledger exists. But 3 duplicate artifacts created for same task. Evidence hash dedup not observed.
Idempotency control.reproducibility: Partial - ledger works, artifact dedup not enforced

Queue scheduling.evidence: FIFO with dependency resolution observed. max_parallel=3 respected (limited by agent pool).

Resource governance.evidence: Limits declared but none tested/hit. No explicit budget decisions made.

Factory failure handling.evidence: 6 scenarios documented but not executed. Only worker_crash equivalent (task failure) observed with no recovery.
